### Patents Act 1970 & Traditional Knowledge IP Assessment (India Jurisdiction)

**Formulation Context Applied:** Evaluated under the classified category *"Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicine"*.

**Patentability Findings:** Under Section 3(p) of the Patents Act 1970, formulations documented in classical First Schedule Samhitas face an absolute non-patentability bar as traditional prior art indexed within the TKDL. To establish patentability in related innovative formulations, the applicant must overcome Section 3(e) by demonstrating statistically significant biological synergy beyond a mere admixture, and fulfill Section 10(4)(d)(ii) by disclosing the exact geographical collection coordinates of all botanical bio-resources.

#### Applicable Statutory Provisions:

**1. Section 3(h) — Ayurvedic Patent or Proprietary Medicine**
• *Authority / Act:* Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules 1945 (Ayush Provisions) (Ministry of Ayush & State Ayush Licensing Authorities (SLA))
• *Statutory Provision:* "A formulation containing ingredients cited in authoritative Ayurvedic texts but formulated in a proportion, vehicle, or dosage form not identical to classical texts."
  *Significance:* Covers innovative Ayurvedic preparations (capsules, syrups, modern extracts). Requires safety and efficacy documentation under Rule 158B.
  *Mandatory Rule:* Eligible for trademark and potentially patent (if proven synergistic under 3(e)). Must obtain proprietary SLA license.

**2. Section 6 — Prior Approval for Intellectual Property Rights (Form III)**
• *Authority / Act:* Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (as amended by 2023 Amendment Act) (National Biodiversity Authority (NBA, Chennai) & State Biodiversity Boards (SBB))
• *Statutory Provision:* "No person shall apply for any intellectual property right, by whatever name called, in or outside India for any invention based on any research or information on a biological resource obtained from India without obtaining the prior approval of the National Biodiversity Authority before grant of patent (Form III)."
  *Significance:* The Indian Patent Office cannot grant a patent until the applicant submits NBA Form III clearance.
  *Mandatory Rule:* Applicants must file Form III with NBA promptly after patent filing and before the patent application proceeds to grant.

**3. Rule 158B — Evidence of Safety and Efficacy for Ayush Proprietary Licensing**
• *Authority / Act:* Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules 1945 (Ayush Provisions) (Ministry of Ayush & State Ayush Licensing Authorities (SLA))
• *Statutory Provision:* "Requires proof of safety, trial data, or published scientific literature for patent or proprietary Ayurvedic formulations depending on whether ingredients are used for classical or newly claimed indications."
  *Significance:* New combinations with non-classical claims require safety pharmacology studies and clinical efficacy documentation.
  *Mandatory Rule:* Determines whether laboratory pilot trials or existing textual safety references will be required for marketing approval.

**4. Section 10(4)(d)(ii) — Mandatory Biological Resource Origin Disclosure**
• *Authority / Act:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))
• *Statutory Provision:* "Every complete specification must disclose the source and geographical origin of the biological material in the specification, when that material is used for the invention."
  *Significance:* Failure to disclose the geographic origin of Indian botanical or biological materials renders the patent liable for rejection or revocation.
  *Mandatory Rule:* Exact collection state/district in India must be cited in the patent application description.

#### Recommended Compliance Actions:

1. **Statutory Clearance Verification**: Cross-verify raw material procurement records to confirm whether bio-resources are cultivated, NTAC-notified, or wild-harvested.
2. **IP Filing Route**: If classical, rely on trademark branding, trade secret extraction techniques, and design protection; if novel extract, substantiate synergism under Section 3(e).
3. **Regulatory Form Submission**: File appropriate applications with the State Licensing Authority (Form 24D/25D) or FSSAI food operator license as appropriate.
4. **NBA/SBB Intimation**: Submit Form III to the National Biodiversity Authority prior to patent grant, or intimate the State Biodiversity Board before commencing commercial batch production.

  *Significance:* Absolute statutory bar preventing patents on classical recipes or known herbal uses documented in Ayurvedic texts.
  *Mandatory Rule:* Formulations documented in the First Schedule Samhitas cannot be patented as products in India.

**2. Section 3 — Access to Biological Resources by Foreign Entities (Form I)**
• *Authority / Act:* Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (as amended by 2023 Amendment Act) (National Biodiversity Authority (NBA, Chennai) & State Biodiversity Boards (SBB))

  *Mandatory Rule:* Failure to obtain NBA prior approval attracts statutory penalties and blocks product commercialization.

  *Mandatory Rule:* Competitors or public bodies can challenge invalid traditional knowledge patents free of official fee under Section 25(1).

2. **IP Filing Route**: If classical, rely on trademark branding, trade secret extraction techniques, and design protection; if novel extract, substantiate synergism under Section 3(e).
3. **Regulatory Form Submission**: File appropriate applications with the State Licensing Authority (Form 24D/25D) or FSSAI food operator license as appropriate.

  *Mandatory Rule:* Competitors or public bodies can challenge invalid traditional knowledge patents free of official fee under Section 25(1).

**4. Section 3(d) — New Form of Known Substance / Incremental Efficacy**

### पेटेंट अधिनियम 1970 एवं पारंपरिक ज्ञान (TK) बौद्धिक संपदा मूल्यांकन (India क्षेत्राधिकार)

**उत्पाद वर्गीकरण संदर्भ:** *"Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicine"* श्रेणी के तहत विश्लेषित किया गया।

**पेटेंट योग्यता वैधानिक निष्कर्ष:** पेटेंट अधिनियम 1970 की **धारा 3(p)** के तहत, प्रथम अनुसूची की संहिताओं में वर्णित शास्त्रीय आयुर्वेदिक योगों पर पेटेंट प्राप्त नहीं किया जा सकता, क्योंकि यह पारंपरिक ज्ञान डिजिटल लाइब्रेरी (TKDL) में पूर्व कला (Prior Art) के रूप में दर्ज हैं। यदि कोई नया या संशोधित योग है, तो **धारा 3(e)** के अंतर्गत वैज्ञानिक रूप से सिनर्जिस्टिक प्रभाव (Synergy) सिद्ध करना अनिवार्य है तथा **धारा 10(4)(d)(ii)** के तहत जैविक संसाधनों का भौगोलिक स्रोत प्रकट करना आवश्यक है।

**1. Section 3(p) — Traditional Knowledge Non-Patentability Bar**
• *अधिनियम / प्राधिकरण:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))

  *वैधानिक प्रभाव:* Formulations documented in the First Schedule Samhitas cannot be patented as products in India.

**2. Section 3 — Access to Biological Resources by Foreign Entities (Form I)**

  *वैधानिक प्रभाव:* Failure to obtain NBA prior approval attracts statutory penalties and blocks product commercialization.

**3. Section 25 & 64 — Opposition & Revocation on Traditional Knowledge Grounds**
• *अधिनियम / प्राधिकरण:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))
• *कानूनी प्रावधान:* "Section 25(1)(k) and 64(1)(p) allow pre-grant and post-grant opposition as well as revocation of a patent if the complete specification does not disclose or wrongly mentions the source or geographical origin of biological material, or if the invention was anticipated having regard to traditional knowledge."

**4. Section 3(d) — New Form of Known Substance / Incremental Efficacy**
• *अधिनियम / प्राधिकरण:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))

#### अनुशंसित कानूनी अनुपालन कदम:

1. **कच्चे माल का वैधानिक सत्यापन**: प्रमाणित करें कि जैविक संसाधन खेती से प्राप्त हैं, NTAC-अधिसूचित हैं या जंगलों से एकत्र किए गए हैं।

### पेटंट कायदा १९७० व पारंपारिक ज्ञान (TK) बौद्धिक संपदा मूल्यांकन (India अधिकारक्षेत्र)

**उत्पादन वर्गीकरण संदर्भ:** *"Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicine"* या श्रेणीनुसार मूल्यमापन केले गेले.

**पेटंट कायदेशीर निष्कर्ष:** पेटंट कायदा १९७० च्या **कलम ३(p)** नुसार, पहिल्या अनुसूचीतील संहितेत नोंदवलेल्या पारंपारिक आयुर्वेदिक सूत्रांवर पेटंट घेता येत नाही. ही सूत्रे पारंपारिक ज्ञान डिजिटल लायब्ररी (TKDL) मध्ये नोंदलेली आहेत. नवीन किंवा सुधारित सूत्रांसाठी **कलम ३(e)** अंतर्गत घटकांमधील सिनर्जिस्टिक प्रभाव (Synergy) वैज्ञानिकदृष्ट्या सिद्ध करणे बंधनकारक आहे आणि **कलम १०(४)(d)(ii)** नुसार जैविक संसाधनांचे भौगोलिक मूळ जाहीर करणे आवश्यक आहे.

#### लागू कायदेशीर कलमे (Statutory Sections):

**1. Section 3(p) — Traditional Knowledge Non-Patentability Bar**
• *कायदा / प्राधिकरण:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))
• *कायदेशीर तरतूद:* "An invention which in effect is traditional knowledge or which is an aggregation or duplication of known properties of traditionally known component or components is not an invention within the meaning of this Act."
  *महत्त्व:* Absolute statutory bar preventing patents on classical recipes or known herbal uses documented in Ayurvedic texts.
  *वैधानिक नियम:* Formulations documented in the First Schedule Samhitas cannot be patented as products in India.

**2. Section 25 & 64 — Opposition & Revocation on Traditional Knowledge Grounds**
• *कायदा / प्राधिकरण:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))
• *कायदेशीर तरतूद:* "Section 25(1)(k) and 64(1)(p) allow pre-grant and post-grant opposition as well as revocation of a patent if the complete specification does not disclose or wrongly mentions the source or geographical origin of biological material, or if the invention was anticipated having regard to traditional knowledge."
  *महत्त्व:* CSIR/TKDL regularly files pre-grant third-party observations based on Samhita citations against vulnerable patent claims.
  *वैधानिक नियम:* Competitors or public bodies can challenge invalid traditional knowledge patents free of official fee under Section 25(1).

**3. Section 3(d) — New Form of Known Substance / Incremental Efficacy**
• *कायदा / प्राधिकरण:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))
• *कायदेशीर तरतूद:* "The mere discovery of a new form of a known substance which does not result in the enhancement of the known efficacy of that substance, or the mere discovery of any new property or new use for a known substance, is not patentable."
  *महत्त्व:* Novel delivery forms (e.g. phyto-liposomes, nano-curcumin) must demonstrate therapeutic efficacy enhancement over classical extract.
  *वैधानिक नियम:* Increased bioavailability alone is insufficient unless accompanied by clinically proven therapeutic efficacy improvements.

**4. Section 3(e) — Mere Admixture / Synergistic Activity Mandate**
• *कायदा / प्राधिकरण:* The Patents Act, 1970 (as amended) (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM))
• *कायदेशीर तरतूद:* "A substance obtained by a mere admixture resulting only in the aggregation of the properties of the components thereof or a process for producing such substance is not patentable without conclusive scientific demonstration of synergistic therapeutic efficacy."
  *महत्त्व:* Polyherbal combinations must prove statistical and experimental synergy (greater than additive effect) to overcome 3(e) objections.
  *वैधानिक नियम:* Applicant must provide in-vitro/in-vivo synergistic data (e.g., Combination Index < 1.0) showing mutual potentiation.

#### अनुशंसित कायदेशीर कृती आराखडा:

1. **कच्च्या मालाची पडताळणी**: जैविक संसाधने शेतातून मिळवली आहेत, NTAC-अधिसूचित आहेत की जंगलातून गोळा केली आहेत याची नोंद ठेवा.
2. **बौद्धिक संपदा धोरण**: पारंपारिक उत्पादनासाठी ट्रेडमार्क आणि डिझाइन संरक्षणाचा वापर करा; नाविन्यपूर्ण अर्कासाठी कलम ३(e) नुसार सिनर्जी सिद्ध करा.
3. **परवाना अर्ज**: राज्य आयुष परवाना प्राधिकरणाकडे (फॉर्म 24D/25D) किंवा FSSAI कडे आवश्यक परवान्यासाठी अर्ज करा.
4. **NBA/SBB पूर्वपरवानगी**: पेटंट मिळण्यापूर्वी NBA फॉर्म III भरा आणि व्यावसायिक उत्पादनापूर्वी राज्य जैवविविधता मंडळाला (SBB) पूर्वसूचना द्या.

> *वैधानिक सूचना: हे स्वयंचलित कायदेशीर विश्लेषण केवळ नियामक संशोधन आणि माहितीसाठी आहे. व्यावसायिक अर्ज दाखल करण्यापूर्वी नोंदणीकृत पेटंट वकील किंवा आयुष कायदेशीर सल्लागाराचा सल्ला घ्या.*

citations.document: Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) & Traditional Medicine Search Guidelines
citations.heading: Guidelines for Examination of Traditional Medicine and Herbal Claims
citations.text: International preliminary examiners must scrutinize claims directed to herbal compositions against classical databases. Where a composition consists of known herbs for their known traditional therapeutic indications, examiners issue negative international search and examination reports on lack of inventive step under PCT Article 33(3) unless unexpected synergy is substantiated.

citations.heading: International Prior Art Definition for Patent Search
citations.text: For the purposes of international patent search under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT), relevant prior art shall consist of everything which has been made available to the public anywhere in the world by means of written disclosure (including non-patent classical medical treatises) before the international filing date. Published Ayurvedic pharmacopoeias and Samhitas form part of this mandatory PCT minimum search documentation.

citations.heading: Dietary Supplement vs Botanical Drug Pathway in the United States
citations.text: Under the Dietary Supplement Health and Education Act (DSHEA 1994), Ayurvedic herbs are marketed as dietary supplements with structure/function claims (no disease treatment claims). To market as a therapeutic drug, the sponsor must file an Investigational New Drug (IND) under FDA's Botanical Drug Development Guidance demonstrating batch-to-batch chemical fingerprint consistency and clinical efficacy.
